gaps.description: PostgresCostGateway financial writes still need the production tenant-aware pool/service-role composition. HTTP reads are RLS-aware, but the writer currently uses its supplied DSN directly and is not claimed ready with lumi_app RLS sessions.

apps/api does not yet formally declare asyncpg and the lumi-model-gateway workspace edge in project dependencies/uv.lock. Hosted tests use an explicit test-only asyncpg overlay; standalone lumi-api frozen deployment is not claimed.
Provider invoice/raw billing reconciliation and automatic discrepancy ingestion are not composed. Immutable ADJUSTMENT/REVERSAL primitives exist.
Unknown-cost Actual rows are preserved with zero amount plus unknown confidence/provenance, but the background reconciler that later appends ADJUSTMENT facts is not scheduled.
Budget/quota tables and immutable change-audit schema exist, but reviewed administrator create/update/approval workflows are not exposed in the P0 public API.
Quota lease/check primitives exist, but Asset Storage, image/video generation and other downstream call sites are not all wired to them yet.
Cost anomaly dashboards, budget burn alerts and reconciliation SLOs are not composed; NODE-67 owns production observability.

Hosted GitHub Actions cannot start while the repository account payment/spending-limit condition prevents runner allocation. No hosted gate may be claimed PASS until runner_id is non-zero and steps execute.
